decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PS-24SSH-01; PS-24SSH-02. Received: 24/08/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The window formed in the eastern flank elevation facing the rear garden of 26 Sutton Square shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse known as "24 Sutton Square, Hounslow, TW5 0JQ" and shall not be occupied as primary residential accommodation or as a separate dwelling or for business use.
description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding to be use as gym and storage ancillary to the main use of the house
